title: 一切按数据说话  (Everything Speaks Through Data)

segments.t: Back at Xingtian after her unnerving meeting at Fentuan Tech, Bu Xiaogu reports to Wang Er and Xingzi that the data points to pop idol Yin Zhengyu — already on Chun Yuqiao's shortlist. Listen first.
我终于明白为什么你们不去见吉秀了。
进来。
好的，王老师。
怎么样了？
吉总推荐最近两个星期的最佳人选尹正宇。
吉总说一切按数据说话。
那总编室那边怎么看？
尹正宇是我们确定的三个最佳人选之一。
这淳于乔还真行，什么都想在我前面。
Let's walk through Xiaogu's report. First, still catching her breath at her desk, she jokes about Ji Xiu.
我终于明白为什么你们不去见吉秀了。
'I finally understand why none of you went to see Ji Xiu.' Relief and sudden insight come through in "zhongyu", 'finally', paired with "mingbai", 'understand', and "weishenme", 'why'.
进来。
'Come in.' Notice the direction built into "jinlai": "jin" means enter, and "lai" points toward the speaker sitting inside the office — unlike "jinqu", which points away from the speaker.
好的，王老师。
'Alright, Teacher Wang.' Crisp "hao de" is the polite, professional cousin of plain "hao" whenever you accept a boss's call or instruction.
怎么样了？
'How did it go?' Adding "le" onto "zenmeyang" shifts 'how is it?' into 'how did things turn out now?' — the quickest way to ask for a progress update.
吉总推荐最近两个星期的最佳人选尹正宇。
'President Ji recommends the top candidate of the past two weeks, Yin Zhengyu.' Here "zuijin" means 'recently', and "zuijia" is a crisp formal word for 'best' or 'optimal'.
吉总说一切按数据说话。
'President Ji says everything speaks according to the data.' Useful "an" means 'according to' before "shuju", 'data', while "yiqie" covers 'everything'.
那总编室那边怎么看？
'Then how does the chief editor's office see it?' Ask anyone's opinion in three syllables with "zenme kan", literally 'how look at it?'.
尹正宇是我们确定的三个最佳人选之一。
'Yin Zhengyu is one of the three top candidates we settled on.' Unlike English 'one of the three', Mandarin names the whole group first and tacks "zhiyi", 'one of them', onto the very end.
这淳于乔还真行，什么都想在我前面。

'This Chun Yuqiao really is capable — he thinks of everything ahead of me.' Earlier we read this character "hang" for 'profession'; here it is read "xing" and means 'capable' or 'good at it' in "zhen xing". Now listen to the whole data report again.
我终于明白为什么你们不去见吉秀了。
进来。
好的，王老师。
怎么样了？
吉总推荐最近两个星期的最佳人选尹正宇。
吉总说一切按数据说话。
那总编室那边怎么看？
尹正宇是我们确定的三个最佳人选之一。
这淳于乔还真行，什么都想在我前面。
Both the outside data and Chun Yuqiao's shortlist point to Yin Zhengyu. Next, Xingzi steps up to reach out to his agency. You learned "jinlai", "zenme kan", and "zhiyi" for "one of".
下次见！
